categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Sprint Precision Technologies Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of precision metal components for semiconductor equipment, focusing on key parts for etching and thin film deposition equipment. The company also extends its precision manufacturing capabilities to other sectors such as medical devices and photovoltaic modules. Its product portfolio includes process components like chambers, liners, heaters, gas distribution plates, and structural components, as well as module assembly and surface treatment services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced precision mechanical manufacturing, surface treatment, welding technologies, high-end device design and development, and customized tooling development. Key production methods include ultra-precision cutting, anodizing, chemical nickel plating, vacuum brazing, electron beam welding, and robotic automated welding. It emphasizes high precision, cleanliness, corrosion resistance, and thermal uniformity to meet semiconductor manufacturing standards, especially for advanced process nodes like 7nm and below.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Its primary customers are leading domestic semiconductor equipment manufacturers such as Zhongwei Semiconductor, North Huachuang, Tuojing Technology, Huahai Qingke, SMIC, and Yitang Technology. The company serves the semiconductor equipment industry, particularly in etching and thin film deposition equipment segments, and also supplies precision components to medical and photovoltaic equipment sectors. The end markets are mainly semiconductor wafer fabrication and advanced chip manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates within Mainland China, with its headquarters and production facilities located in Jiangsu Province, including subsidiaries in Jingjiang and Wuxi. It also has a sales subsidiary in Singapore. The majority of its revenue is generated from the domestic Chinese market, with some sales to overseas markets primarily in medical device components.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Sprint Precision Technologies operates in the upstream to midstream segment of the semiconductor equipment supply chain, specializing in the design, manufacturing, and assembly of critical precision metal components that are integral to semiconductor fabrication equipment. It acts as a key supplier to semiconductor equipment manufacturers, providing core parts essential for device fabrication processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes deepening its technological capabilities in precision manufacturing, surface treatment, welding, and high-end device design to support advanced semiconductor process nodes. It focuses on R&D to enhance product performance, expand product categories, and improve production efficiency. Strategic R&D initiatives include developing advanced process components, surface treatment technologies for higher corrosion resistance and cleanliness, welding process innovations, and expanding into new precision manufacturing fields such as medical and photovoltaic sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of precision metal components and assembled modules to semiconductor equipment manufacturers and other industrial clients. The company operates on a direct sales model, negotiating prices based on production costs, market competition, and target profit margins. It also provides surface treatment and assembly services as part of its product offerings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic precision parts supplier in the semiconductor equipment industry, recognized as a national 'specialized and innovative' small giant enterprise. It competes with international suppliers from the US, Europe, and Japan, especially in advanced process components. Its close collaboration with major domestic semiconductor equipment manufacturers and early involvement in 7nm and below process node components provide it with a competitive edge in the Chinese market amid the ongoing localization and import substitution trends.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.136 billion, representing a 103.65% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 213.95 million, a 166.52% increase. Total assets reached RMB 1.978 billion, up 84.72% from the previous year, supported by a successful IPO raising over RMB 512 million. The company has shown rapid growth driven by the semiconductor industry's recovery and domestic equipment demand, with a strong R&D investment ratio of 5.64% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its technological innovation and precision manufacturing capabilities, offering highly customized, high-precision, and high-cleanliness metal components critical for advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its differentiated value lies in its ability to meet stringent semiconductor process requirements, including ultra-fine machining tolerances, advanced surface treatments, and reliable welding technologies. The company’s close collaboration with leading domestic semiconductor equipment manufacturers and its role in supporting the localization of key components for advanced process nodes underpin its competitive advantage.
